通用字节流仪器通信接口
device_entry.description: 这是一个非物理的软件通信组件，用于向 Pylon 相关接口发送请求、获取指定类型的回复，并在实验软件流程中关闭通信连接。它更像是实验系统中的通信辅助模块，而不是直接控制某台具体硬件仪器的设备。
device_entry.description_en: This is a non-physical software communication component used to send requests to a Pylon-related interface, obtain replies of a specified type, and close the communication connection within laboratory software workflows. It appears to be a communication helper module rather than direct control of a specific hardware instrument.

schema.description: 发送请求并获取指定类型的回复。
schema.description_en: Send a request and get a reply of the specified type.
